headline: Malaysian Palm Oil Futures Fall 0.7% on Weaker Soyoil Competition
summary: Malaysian palm oil benchmark futures for February delivery fell 32 ringgit to 4,301 ringgit per metric ton, posting a fourth consecutive session loss due to weakness in global soybean oil prices.
why: Bursa Malaysia Derivatives is the world's primary pricing exchange for crude palm oil, a key agricultural commodity for global food production.

impacts.name: Palm Oil Futures
impacts.why: Palm oil futures declined 0.74% due to spillover weakness in competing vegetable oil markets.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Declining prices in rival soy oil markets lowered demand and pricing support for Malaysian palm oil futures.
